kpis.description_en: CooperVision = contact lenses. ~70% of Cooper revenue. Growth in myopia management (MiSight) + silicone hydrogel.

kpis.description_en: CooperSurgical = women's health + fertility. Strong growth post Cook Medical (2023) repro health acquisition.

kpis.description_en: MiSight = contact lenses to slow children's myopia. Only FDA-approved product in USA. Rapid adoption.

kpis.description_fr: 56 % du CA hors USA, dont fort EMEA + Asie-Pacifique. Diversification structurelle.
kpis.description_en: 56% of revenue outside USA, strong EMEA + Asia-Pacific. Structural diversification.

kpis.description_fr: Mix lentilles silicone hydrogel (haute oxygénation, confort). Premium ASP + récurrent. Migration depuis lentilles traditionnelles.
kpis.description_en: Silicone hydrogel lens mix (high O2 permeability, comfort). Premium ASP + recurring. Migration from traditional lenses.
